title: Atomic answer
content: Atomic answer is the agency Animalz's name for a short passage that handles one question and holds its meaning when lifted away from the rest of the page.

meta.why: A passage quoted out of context keeps its meaning when the passage names its subject and states its conditions.
meta.example: A paragraph states that a store ships orders placed before 2 p.m. Eastern on the same business day, with the store's name and the exclusions in the same paragraph.
meta.check: Copy one answer paragraph into a blank document. Can a reader tell what the paragraph refers to and when the answer applies?
meta.limitation: The idea overlaps with extractability, and no engine promises a citation for a passage written this way.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
